input: Create /scripts/report.sh that uses getopts to parse these options: -f <format> (output format: csv or json, default csv), -o <file> (output file, default stdout), -v (verbose mode flag), -h (print usage and exit). After parsing, the script should read /data/input.csv and: if format is csv, output it as-is; if format is json, convert each row to a JSON object. Run the script with: 'bash /scripts/report.sh -f json -v' to process the input in verbose mode. Verbose mode should print 'Verbose: processing N rows' before output.

mkdir -p /scripts
cat > /scripts/report.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

usage() {
    printf 'Usage: %s [-f csv|json] [-o file] [-v] [-h]\n' "$0"
}

format=csv
output=
verbose=false
while getopts ':f:o:vh' opt; do
    case "$opt" in
        f) format=$OPTARG ;;
        o) output=$OPTARG ;;
        v) verbose=true ;;
        h) usage; exit 0 ;;
        :) printf 'Error: -%s requires an argument\n' "$OPTARG" >&2; usage >&2; exit 1 ;;
        \?) printf 'Error: unknown option -%s\n' "$OPTARG" >&2; usage >&2; exit 1 ;;
    esac
done
shift "$((OPTIND - 1))"
if (( $# > 0 )); then
    printf 'Error: unexpected positional arguments\n' >&2
    usage >&2
    exit 1
fi
case "$format" in
    csv|json) ;;
    *) printf 'Error: format must be csv or json\n' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

input=/data/input.csv
if [[ ! -r "$input" ]]; then
    printf 'Error: cannot read %s\n' "$input" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if "$verbose"; then
    rows=$(awk 'END { print (NR > 0 ? NR - 1 : 0) }' "$input")
    printf 'Verbose: processing %s rows\n' "$rows" >&2
fi

render() {
    if [[ "$format" == csv ]]; then
        cat "$input"
    else
        # The first row supplies the object keys; cell values remain strings.
        jq -Rn '
            [inputs | rtrimstr("\r") | split(",")] as $rows
            | if ($rows | length) == 0 then []
              else $rows[0] as $headers
                | [$rows[1:][] as $row
                   | reduce range(0; $headers | length) as $i
                     ({}; .[$headers[$i]] = ($row[$i] // ""))]
              end
        ' < "$input"
    fi
}

if [[ -n "$output" ]]; then
    render > "$output"
else
    render
fi
EOF
chmod +x /scripts/report.sh
bash /scripts/report.sh -f json -v
